confirm: To approve this change, reply exactly ACTION {reference}. This approval expires in five minutes.
code: Check the email address held by the business. Reply VERIFY {reference} followed by the six-digit code. The code expires in five minutes.
failed: I could not safely complete the action. A change may already have been applied. Our team will help you check before trying again.
unavailable: Use the connected customer chat to approve an action.
invalid: That approval or code is invalid, expired, or already used. Request the action again if needed.
